disorder-name.detail: DSM-IV-TR / SCID-IV diagnosed schizophrenia across seven study sites (AMC, COBRE, fBIRN, JNUH, MCIC, NMorphCH, UCLA). NM applied by computing z-scores of PBSI scores using HC group mean and SD to classify deviant patients.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "We used neuroimaging data from 420 healthy controls and 695 patients with SCZ from seven studies." "We used a normative model in which the deviant and other patients were divided using the z scores of the PBSI scores. [...] We calculated the z score of the PBSI score using the mean and S.D. of the PBSI scores in the control group."
disorder-name.location: Joo2024.pdf.md: Abstract, L47; Methods / Statistical analysis, L103

dataset-of-origin.detail: Seven datasets used for the SCZ clinical cohort: (1) AMC – Asan Medical Center, Korea (local single-site; no matching normalized keyword); (2) COBRE → keyword 'COBRE'; (3) fBIRN – Function Biomedical Informatics Research Network (no matching keyword in list); (4) JNUH – Jeonbuk National University Hospital, Korea (local single-site; no matching keyword); (5) MCIC → keyword 'MCIC'; (6) NMorphCH – Neuromorphometry by Computer Algorithm Chicago, Northwestern University (no definitive keyword match; possibly related to NUSDAST but not confirmed); (7) UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics LA5c Study → keyword 'UCLA-LA5c'. AMC, JNUH, fBIRN, and NMorphCH do not have clear matches in the normalized keyword list and are therefore omitted from the answer array.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "We included neuroimaging datasets acquired from two tertiary hospitals in the Republic of Korea, the Asan Medical Center (AMC) and Jeonbuk National University Hospital (JNUH). [...] From the SchizConnect database [...] we obtained Center of Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE), Neuromorphometry by Computer Algorithm Chicago (NMorphCH), MIND Clinical Imaging Consortium (MCIC), and Function Biomedical Informatics Research Network (fBIRN) datasets. Neuroimaging and clinical data from University of California Los Angeles Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics LA5c Study (UCLA) were downloaded from OpenNeuro."

age.detail: Overall SCZ cohort mean and SD reported directly in Table 1 (rightmost SCZ column). Min/max not reported for the combined cohort. Site-specific age range: AMC patients were described as aged 20–40 years (supplementary Study population section), but this applies to AMC only and cannot be generalized to the full cohort.

sex.detail: Male N=382 (55%) reported directly in Table 1 overall SCZ column. Female N estimated as 695 − 382 = 313; female % = 313/695 × 100 = 45.0%.
